assertions.text: Includes an explicit severity classification with concise rationale tied to user/financial impact.
Provides at least three concrete 'needs test:' lines specific to the retry-payment path.
Test suggestions include idempotency and timeout/retry behavior, not only generic happy-path checks.
Provides a severity level and clearly states uncertainty due to missing logs/repro details.
Includes concrete 'needs test:' lines with iOS Safari-focused reproduction variables.
Requests the minimal missing evidence needed to refine severity confidence (e.g., logs, release window, repro steps).
Explicitly calls out insufficient evidence and avoids presenting a definitive severity as certain.
Includes targeted clarification requests before final severity lock-in.
Provides actionable 'needs test:' lines despite ambiguity, including data-loss prevention scenarios.
